purpose: Teach: 序文/ステートメント/コーティング/受領/取締り/移管/とりまとめ/仲間入り

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、年次報告書の序文は私が書く
lines.en: I'll be writing the preface to our annual report.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact declaration. Clipped cadence, no flourish. Authoritative but not unkind — a statement of fact from someone used to being heard.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。公式ステートメントの草案を準備しました
lines.en: Understood. I've prepared a draft of the official statement.
lines.style: Quiet, attentive. Direct report without elaboration. Professional respect — not stiff, just precise. Pace steady and efficient.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社の新製品、コーティング技術を改良しろ
lines.en: I want the coating technology in our new product line improved.
lines.style: Clear directive. Slight forward lean in the delivery. Not harsh, but expectant — the tone of someone assigning work to someone trusted.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様からの受領書を整理しました
lines.en: Understood. I've organized the client receipts and documentation.
lines.style: Brief, efficient report. Professional nod in the voice — acknowledgment that the task is done and logged. No elaboration needed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、コンプライアンス取締りを強化しろ
lines.en: Strengthen our compliance enforcement across all departments.
lines.style: Firm, deliberate. Weight on 「強化」. Not aggressive, but unmistakable intent. The tone of someone raising standards, not lowering them.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。プロジェクトを子会社に移管する案を検討中です
lines.en: Understood. We're examining a proposal to transfer the project to a subsidiary.
lines.style: Measured update. Thoughtful pace — this is more complex than the previous reports. Shows he's thinking through the solution.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 部門意見のとりまとめを早急にしろ
lines.style: Sharp, urgent without being panicked. The words come with a sense of priority. Lean into the tempo — this one matters now.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。業界団体への仲間入りを実現します
lines.en: Understood. I'll make sure we secure our industry association membership.
lines.style: Firm close. Slight lift at the end — a promise of completion. Confident without overstepping. Respectful finality.
